comps.label: water drops
comps.says: The side form of 水 (water): three drops. It marks characters about liquids, rivers and seas.

comps.label: hand side
comps.says: The side form of 手 (hand). It marks actions done with the hand: lifting, holding, hitting.

comps.label: grass top
comps.says: Two sprouts of grass, the top form of 草 (grass). It marks plants, herbs and flowers.

comps.label: person side
comps.says: The side form of 人 (person), a person standing. It marks characters about people and what they do.

comps.label: roof
comps.says: A picture of a roof seen from the side. It marks houses, homes and things kept safe under cover.

comps.label: speech side
comps.says: The simplified side form of 言 (words, speech). It marks characters about speaking, words and thinking.

comps.label: walking road
comps.says: A foot moving along a road. It marks characters about going, passing, roads and distance.

comps.label: silk strand
comps.says: The simplified side form of 糸 (silk): a twisted thread. It marks threads, weaving, tying and joining.

comps.label: flesh moon
comps.says: A narrow form of 月 (moon) that in most characters stands for 肉 (flesh); it marks body parts, and is also a shape left from other old parts.

comps.label: ear hill
comps.says: Two parts share this shape: on the left it is 阜 (mound, hill), on the right 邑 (town). It marks hills, walls and place names.

comps.label: cloth cover
comps.says: A cloth or lid laid over something. It means covering, but in most characters it is only shape.

comps.label: lid top
comps.says: A dot over a line, a top found in many characters. It has no meaning of its own; shape only, from varied origins.

comps.label: knife side
comps.says: The side form of 刀 (knife), standing up. It marks cutting, dividing and things done with a blade.

comps.label: private loop
comps.says: A small loop, the original form of 私 (private, self). In most characters it is only shape, sometimes a squeezed mouth or arm.

comps.label: heart side
comps.says: The side form of 心 (heart), standing up. It marks feelings, moods and thoughts.

comps.label: trudging foot
comps.says: A foot pointing down, coming or walking slowly. It hints at movement or arrival, but often is only shape.

comps.label: metal side
comps.says: The simplified side form of 金 (gold, metal). It marks metals and things made of metal.

comps.label: tapping hand
comps.says: A hand holding a stick, to tap or strike. It marks actions: making, teaching, forcing, changing.

comps.label: wrapping arm
comps.says: A bent arm or body curled around something, the original of 包 (wrap). It suggests wrapping, sometimes only shape.

comps.label: mowing shears
comps.says: A scissors-like tool for cutting grass. In most characters it is just a crossing shape, standing for things crossed or mixed.

comps.label: little sparks
comps.says: A top form of 小 (small): three short strokes. Often only shape, sometimes standing for small or for light.

comps.label: left hand
comps.says: A picture of a left hand, the original form of 左 (left). In characters it usually stands for a hand holding something.

comps.label: short-tailed bird
comps.says: A picture of a short-tailed bird. It marks birds, and also gives the sound zhui/sui/wei.

comps.label: bamboo top
comps.says: The top form of 竹 (bamboo): two bamboo twigs with leaves. It marks things made of bamboo: slips, pipes, baskets.

comps.label: two horns
comps.says: Two short strokes, often a squeezed form of 八 (eight, divide) or two horns. Mostly shape.

comps.label: ink dot
comps.says: A single dot stroke. It is used as a mark or flame tip, but in most characters it is only shape.

comps.label: twin posts
comps.says: The top of 共 (together) and 昔 (past); in 共 it came from two hands holding something up. Mostly shape.

comps.label: sickbed
comps.says: A picture of a bed or stretcher for the sick. It marks illnesses, pain and disease.

comps.label: foot bottom
comps.says: The bottom of 足 (foot) and 走 (walk), from 止 (foot, stop). It brings the idea of feet and moving.

comps.label: ice drops
comps.says: The side form of 冰 (ice): two drops. It marks cold and ice, but in many characters it is only shape.

comps.label: bent top
comps.says: A short slant with a bar, from different old parts: a flag top in 族 (clan), a head ornament in 每 (every). Shape only.

comps.label: stepping foot
comps.says: The left half of 行 (crossroads). It marks walking, roads and going somewhere.

comps.label: claw top
comps.says: The top form of 爪 (claw): a hand reaching down. It marks taking, picking and grasping.

comps.label: knife cap
comps.says: A slanted cap, from 刀 (knife) or 人 (person) in different characters. Mostly shape.

comps.label: crouching man
comps.says: A person kneeling or crouching, a variant of 卩. Mostly shape; in 犯 and 范 it helps give the sound fan.

comps.label: dog side
comps.says: The side form of 犬 (dog). It marks animals and wild or fierce behavior.

comps.label: knife cap
comps.says: A slanted cap, from 刀 (knife) or 人 (person) in different characters. Mostly shape.

comps.label: enclosure
comps.says: A wall around an area. It marks enclosed things: countries, gardens, being surrounded or trapped.

comps.label: fire dots
comps.says: The bottom form of 火 (fire): four flames. It marks heat, cooking and burning, sometimes only shape.

comps.label: hair strands
comps.says: Three slanted strokes, strands of hair or rays. It marks decoration, color, shape and patterns.

comps.label: towering stand
comps.says: A tall platform or a person with a big head. In 元 and 完 it is a person; often it gives the sound yuan/wan.

comps.label: jade side
comps.says: The side form of 玉 (jade), looks like 王 (king). It marks jade, gems and precious things.

comps.label: net top
comps.says: The top form of 网 (net); in some characters it is a flattened 目 (eye). It marks nets, catching and punishment.

comps.label: old man top
comps.says: The top of 老 (old): an old man with long hair. It hints at old age, or is only shape as in 者.

comps.label: crack mark
comps.says: A form of 卜 (divine): a crack in a burnt bone. It gives the sound zhan in 占 (divine) and its family.

comps.label: open box
comps.says: A box open on one side. It marks containers and things kept in a frame.

comps.label: snout
comps.says: A pig's snout; in most characters it is really a hand (又) drawn sideways. Mostly shape.

comps.label: glaring eye
comps.says: An eye over a turned person, origin unclear, meaning blunt or stubborn. It gives the sound -en/-in in 很, 根, 跟, 银.

comps.label: food side
comps.says: The simplified side form of 食 (food, eat). It marks food, meals and hunger.

comps.label: breath line
comps.says: A wavy line showing breath meeting an obstacle. It gives the sound kao/qiao/kua in characters like 考 and 巧.

comps.label: open pit
comps.says: A pit or container open at the top. It hints at holding or a hollow, often only shape.

comps.label: split legs
comps.says: Two legs standing apart, the bottom of 介 (go-between) and 乔. Shape only; origin unclear.

comps.label: clothing side
comps.says: The side form of 衣 (clothing). It marks clothes and cloth.

comps.label: can frame
comps.says: The hook-shaped frame of 可 (can), left after taking out the 口 (mouth). Shape only; in its characters 可 gives the sound ke/he/a.

comps.label: green sprout
comps.says: The top of 青 (blue-green), from 生 (grow): a plant sprouting from the earth. It brings the sound qing/jing.

comps.label: spear hand
comps.says: A hand holding a spear or club. It marks striking and actions done with force.

comps.label: wide frame
comps.says: A large room or platform, meaning wide or far. Mostly a frame shape around other parts.

comps.label: tiny thread
comps.says: A single twisted thread, meaning tiny or young. It hints at smallness or thread.

comps.label: eye side
comps.says: The left side of 临 (look down) and 监 (supervise), from 臣: an eye turned upright. It brings the idea of looking.

comps.label: corner stroke
comps.says: A single stroke going down then right, a corner. Shape only.

comps.label: scattered sparks
comps.says: Small scattered strokes at the top of 学 (study) and 兴 (thrive), from older hands or crosses. Shape only; origin varies.

comps.label: bent figure
comps.says: The left half of 比 (compare), one of two people side by side. Shape only in most characters.

comps.label: altar side
comps.says: The side form of 示 (altar, show). It marks gods, rites, blessings and prayers.

comps.label: water bottom
comps.says: The bottom form of 水 (water), drops spread out. It hints at water, sometimes only shape.

comps.label: food bowl
comps.says: The left side of 即 (right away) and 既 (done eating), from 皀: a bowl of food. It gives the idea of eating or the sound ji/gai.

comps.label: tent top
comps.says: The top of 帝 (emperor) and 旁 (beside): a dot, bar and lid. Shape only; origin unclear.

comps.label: silk skein
comps.says: A picture of twisted silk threads, the full form of 纟. It marks thread, rope and tying.

comps.label: ox top
comps.says: A top form of 牛 (ox), as in 告 (tell). In most characters it is only shape.

comps.label: cliff slope
comps.says: A slope or cliff edge, like 厂. In 反 (reverse) and its family it is mostly shape.

comps.label: kneeling man
comps.says: A person kneeling. It hints at a person bowing or obeying, or a seal, and is often only shape.

comps.label: leaning person
comps.says: The right corner of 临 (look down) and 监 (supervise), from 人: a person bending over to look.

comps.label: two hands
comps.says: A picture of two hands held up. It marks lifting, holding or offering something with both hands.

comps.label: hog
comps.says: A picture of a pig. It marks pigs and gives the sound in some characters like 家 (home).

comps.label: upright line
comps.says: A single vertical stroke. Shape only.

comps.label: west lid
comps.says: A lid-like top, shape of 西 (west); in 要 (want) it was two hands at a waist. Mostly shape.

comps.label: tether post
comps.says: A post for tying animals, later used for shooting with a corded arrow. It gives the sound dai/shi in 代, 式, 试.

comps.label: bundled hands
comps.says: Bars over crossed lines, the top of 春, 奉 and 奏; it came from two hands holding up something. Mostly shape.

comps.label: clay jar
comps.says: A picture of a pot with a lid. It marks jars and pottery, and gives the sound yao/tao.

comps.label: hook stroke
comps.says: A horizontal stroke ending in a hook. Shape only.

comps.label: long stride
comps.says: A long stride. It hints at stretching or going far, as in 延 (prolong), often only shape.

comps.label: table legs
comps.says: The bottom of 共 (together): two short legs, from two hands holding something up. Shape only.

comps.label: bed board
comps.says: The simplified side form of 爿: a bed or split plank. It gives the sound zhuang/jiang in 装, 状, 将.

comps.label: ice flecks
comps.says: Two small dots, the bottom of 冬 (winter): ice. It hints at cold, or is only shape.

comps.label: heaped top
comps.says: The top of 尧, once earth piled high over a person. It gives the sound rao/shao/xiao in 绕, 烧, 晓.

comps.label: bell hook
comps.says: The hook on top of 甬, a hanging bell. It gives the sound yong/tong in 勇, 通, 桶.

comps.label: book slats
comps.says: Bamboo strips tied together, from 册 (book). In 扁 (flat) and its family it gives the sound bian/pian.

comps.label: flowing hair
comps.says: The bottom of 㐬: a newborn's hair or water flowing at birth. It gives the sound liu/shu/huang in 流, 疏, 荒.

comps.label: stacked bricks
comps.says: Crossed bars stacked in the middle of 寒 and 塞: from bricks or straw piled up. Mostly shape.

comps.label: turn stroke
comps.says: A stroke going right then down, a corner. Shape only.

comps.label: tiger head
comps.says: The head of 虎 (tiger). It marks tigers and gives the sound hu/xu/lu in 虎, 虚, 虑.

comps.label: raised hands
comps.says: Shape at the bottom of 举 (lift up) and 奉 (present): a tall cross with bars, from older forms of hands lifting and of 睪. Mostly shape only.

comps.label: scroll top
comps.says: Top of 卷 (scroll): hands rolling something up. Gives the sound juan/quan (卷, 圈, 券, 拳, 倦).

comps.label: two tens
comps.says: Old character for twenty: two tens joined. In 度, 席, 燕 and 庶 it is mostly shape.

comps.label: stacked spears
comps.says: Simplified 戔: two halberds (戈) stacked, meaning small, sliced thin. Gives the sound jian/qian (钱, 线, 浅, 践, 盏).

comps.label: spread feet
comps.says: Two feet set apart, stepping up. Top of 登 (climb up), which passes the sound deng to 澄, 橙, 凳, 蹬.

comps.label: left sweep
comps.says: The falling-left stroke used as a component. Shape only.

comps.label: horned crown
comps.says: A short crown like grass (艹) or two horns over a bar, top of 前 (front) and 兹. Shape only; origin differs by character.

comps.label: leather band
comps.says: Simplified 韋: feet going around a wall, borrowed for tanned leather. Means going around (围, 违) and gives the sound wei (伟, 纬, 苇).

comps.label: rising rays
comps.says: Right side of 汤, 场 and 扬: simplified rays of the rising sun from 昜. Gives the sound yang/tang/chang.

comps.label: sheep horns
comps.says: Top form of 羊 (sheep) without its tail: horns and head. Brings sheep into 羔 (lamb) and 羹 (broth); shape only in 盖.

comps.label: back half
comps.says: Left half of 北 (north), from two people sitting back to back. Shape only.

comps.label: seed scatter
comps.says: A tool for sowing seeds, or animal tracks; meant telling apart. In 番, 播, 翻 it helps the sound fan/bo; in 悉, 释 meaning or shape.

comps.label: plow handle
comps.says: Picture of a wooden plow. Marks farming work: 耕 (plow), 耘 (weeding), 耙 (rake); in 耗 it is the meaning side.

comps.label: underground stream
comps.says: Right part of 经 (warp thread): threads on a loom, or water flowing underground. Gives the sound jing/qing (经, 轻, 径, 颈, 茎).

comps.label: hook bend
comps.says: A bent stroke ending in a hook, used as a component. Shape only; origin unclear.

comps.label: side ticks
comps.says: Small strokes on both sides of a center, as in 率 (lead rope) and 函 (letter case). Shape only; origin unclear.

comps.label: robe hem
comps.says: Lower shape of 畏 (awe) and 展 (unfold), like the bottom of a robe (衣). Shape only; origin unclear.

comps.label: brush hand
comps.says: A hand (又) holding a writing brush. Meaning or shape in 律 and 建; in 津 it helps the sound jin.

comps.label: steamer grate
comps.says: Middle of 曾 (once before): a steamer with layers and steam rising. With 曾 it gives the sound zeng/ceng (增, 赠, 憎, 僧).

comps.label: long-life top
comps.says: Top of 寿 (long life), from an old furrowed-field shape. With 寿 it gives the sound shou/tao/chou (涛, 筹, 畴, 铸).

comps.label: parting hand
comps.says: Origin unclear; possibly a hand parting something, or an archer's thumb ring. Gives the sound kuai/jue/que (快, 块, 决, 缺).

comps.label: corner hook
comps.says: A stroke turning right then down with a hook. Shape only.

comps.label: rump
comps.says: An animal's track or rump; bottom of 禽 (fowl) and 离 (depart). Shape only now.

comps.label: well pulley
comps.says: Top of 录 (write down), from a well pulley or a bag dripping water. With 录 it gives the sound lu (绿, 碌, 禄).

comps.label: open doors
comps.says: Top of 留 (stay), a variant of 卯 (two doors opened). With 留 it gives the sound liu (瘤, 溜, 榴, 馏); in 贸 mao.

comps.label: staff hand
comps.says: A hand (又) holding a staff of office: to govern. Inside 君 (lord) it gives the sound jun/qun (群, 裙).

comps.label: big-head ape
comps.says: Old picture of a monkey-like creature with a big head. Gives the sound yu/ou (遇, 愚, 寓, 隅, 偶, 藕).

comps.label: meat slab
comps.says: A slanted form of 肉 (meat), seen in 然 (once burning dog meat) and 祭 (offering meat). Now mostly shape.

comps.label: stacked mounds
comps.says: Two stacked mounds or heaps of earth; tied to 以 (use) in old forms. In 官 it is shape; 官 gives the sound guan.

comps.label: torn cloth
comps.says: Left side of 敝 (ruined): a cloth (巾) with small tears. Shape only on its own; see 敝 for the meaning.

comps.label: grand hands
comps.says: Simplified 奐: hands lifting something grand, meaning splendid. Gives the sound huan (换, 唤, 涣, 焕, 痪).

comps.label: flame sparks
comps.says: Top of 尞: wood with sparks around it, a bonfire. Shape only; the sound liao comes with the whole 尞.

comps.label: back foot
comps.says: A foot pointing down, the mirror of 夂: in 降 (descend) two feet go down. In 舞 and 舜-like parts it is shape only.

comps.label: border frame
comps.says: Frame of 周 (circuit): a box open at the bottom, around a field. Shape only.

comps.label: short heap
comps.says: Left side of 师 (teacher) and 归, a short form of 𠂤 (a heap, an army camp). Shape only now.

comps.label: gazing up
comps.says: A standing person (人) beside a kneeling one (卩): looking up, lofty. Gives the sound ang/ying/yang (昂, 迎, 仰).

comps.label: inner room
comps.says: Top of 奥 (profound): a roof over rice or seeds, the deep inner room of a house. With 奥 it gives the sound ao (澳, 懊).

comps.label: twin sacks
comps.says: Top of 曹 (officials): two bags or bundles side by side. With 曹 it gives the sound zao/cao (遭, 糟, 槽).

comps.label: river flow
comps.says: Old form of 川 (river): flowing water. Brings flowing into 巡 (make rounds); shape in 巢, 瑙, 剿.

comps.label: thorn tree
comps.says: A tree or weapon with thorns. Brings thorns and pricking into 刺 (stab) and 棘 (thorns); gives the sound ce/ci (策).

comps.label: bare bones
comps.says: Top of 骨 (bone): a picture of bones at a joint. With 骨 it gives the sound hua/gu (滑, 猾).

comps.label: choking man
comps.says: A kneeling person with mouth turned away, done eating or choking. Right side of 既 (done eating), which gives the sound gai (概, 慨, 溉).

comps.label: brow line
comps.says: An eyebrow over the eye, as in 眉 (eyebrow) and 媚. In 声 and 馨 it is shape only.

comps.label: hanging beard
comps.says: Left side of 那 (that), from 冄 (hanging hair or beard). With 那 it gives the sound na/nuo (哪, 娜, 挪).

comps.label: tall stand
comps.says: Top of 商 (commerce), maybe from an old stand or tall base. In 摘, 滴, 嘀 it is part of 啇, giving the sound di/zhai.

comps.label: torch room
comps.says: Top of 叟: a torch (火) in a house (宀), searching in the dark. With 又 it gives the sound sou (搜, 艘, 嫂, 瘦).

comps.label: heart base
comps.says: Bottom form of 心 (heart), as in 恭 (respectful) and 慕 (admire), bringing feeling. In 添, 舔 it is shape inside 忝.

comps.label: robe tail
comps.says: Lower half of 衣 (clothing), split around a middle part. Brings clothing into 表 (outer coat), 袁 (long robe); shape in 猿, 囊.

comps.label: doorway walker
comps.says: A person (人) going out through a doorway: to move on. Gives the sound shen/zhen/dan/chen (沈, 枕, 耽, 忱).

comps.label: trailing foot
comps.says: Bottom of 步 (step): a reversed foot, the second foot of a step. Shape only outside 步 and its family (涉, 频).

comps.label: crouching beast
comps.says: Picture of a crouching beast with a long back. Marks wild animals: 豹 (leopard), 豺 (jackal); shape in 貌.

comps.label: mound heap
comps.says: Picture of a heap or mound, later an army camp; center of 追 (pursue). Shape only in 埠, 薛, 孽.

comps.label: rover top
comps.says: The left part of 敖 (ramble): a person roving about, drawn with a head-like top. Shape only in its own right.

comps.label: stone ledge
comps.says: Left half of 段 (section): a cliff with chips of stone, struck by a hand with a tool. Brings sound duan.

comps.label: wind frame
comps.says: The outer frame of 风 (wind) without its inside. Shape only; it holds other parts in 凤 (phoenix).

comps.label: plow hook
comps.says: Left part of 以 (by means): once drawn as a plow or tool held by a person. Shape only; origin debated.

comps.label: borrowing hands
comps.says: Old form of 假 (borrow, fake): one hand passing an object to another. Gives sound jia/xia in 假, 暇 (spare time), 霞 (rosy clouds).

comps.label: sorting bundle
comps.says: Simplified 柬 (pick out): a bundle with chosen items. Gives sound lian/jian in 练 (drill), 炼 (smelt), 拣 (sort by hand).

comps.label: tangled cords
comps.says: Two cords twisted together: entangle, gather. Gives sound jiu in 纠 (entangle), 叫 (shout), 收 (gather in).

comps.label: upside-down man
comps.says: A person drawn upside down; original form of 逆 (against). Adds 'going against' and sound ni/su.

comps.label: shading hand
comps.says: A hand (手) drawn slanted, as on top of 看 (look): a hand held over the eyes. Also the hand part in 拜 (bow down).

comps.label: overflow water
comps.says: Water (水) turned on its side above a dish in 益: water spilling over, the original sense of 溢 (spill over).

comps.label: old long
comps.says: Side form of 長 (long): an old person with long flowing hair. Marks hair in 鬓 (temple hair); shape in 套, 肆.

comps.label: pen hand
comps.says: A hand holding a writing brush upright, as in 聿 (brush). In 唐 (tang) it is only shape.

comps.label: night moon
comps.says: The lower right of 夜 (night): a moon (夕) tucked beside a person. Adds the night sense.

comps.label: cliff cap
comps.says: A line with a short stroke down, the top of 夏 and 页-like heads. Shape only; origin unclear.

comps.label: swift flight
comps.says: A bird flying fast with wings spread: rapid. Gives sound xun in 讯 (news), 迅 (swift), 汛 (flood tide).

comps.label: walking foot
comps.says: The inside of 延 (prolong): a foot (止) with a stroke of a long path. Adds walking on, stretching; sound yan/dan.

comps.label: bowing hand
comps.says: The right side of 拜 (bow down): a hand form, so two hands meet in a bow. Shape only beyond that.

comps.label: twin tens
comps.says: Two tens (十) joined: twenty. In 贲 (in 愤, 喷) it is only shape, from a plant-like top.

comps.label: low table
comps.says: A flat top on two legs: a stand or table. In 鼻 (nose) it was a sound part (bi); otherwise shape.

comps.label: book stack
comps.says: The top of 典 (canon): bound bamboo slips, a book (册), set on a stand. Adds the sense of written records.

comps.label: lifting hands
comps.says: Hands lifting a person out of a pit: to aid, rescue. Gives sound zheng and the lifting sense in 拯 (lift out), 蒸 (steamer).

comps.label: belt knots
comps.says: The top of 带 (belt): a sash with knots and hanging ends. Gives the belt shape and sound dai/zhi.

comps.label: split blade
comps.says: A knife (刀) squeezed between two other parts, cutting them apart, as in 班 (squad) and 辨 (distinguish).

comps.label: rod hand
comps.says: A hand (又) holding a stick: to tap, strike. Full form of 攵; marks action in 敲 (knock), 寇 (invader).

comps.label: knee apron
comps.says: A cloth apron hanging from a belt; not 市 (market), its stroke goes through. Gives sound fei/pei in 肺 (lungs), 沛.

comps.label: lame man
comps.says: A person with a bent, crooked leg: lame. Marks awkward standing in 尴尬 (awkward).

comps.label: pierced string
comps.says: Something pierced through and strung, old form of 貫. Gives sound guan in 贯 (coin string), 惯 (habit).

comps.label: spindle
comps.says: A spindle wound with thread, the top of 惠 (favor) and 穗 (grain ear). Shape and sound hui.

comps.label: knee joint
comps.says: A form of 卩, a kneeling person, at the bottom of 节 (festival, once 'joint'). Shape only in 爷 (grandpa).

comps.label: nimble foot
comps.says: A hand over a foot (止): quick, nimble. Gives sound jie in 捷 (quick win), 睫 (eyelash).

comps.label: yellow clay
comps.says: A person over fire with mouth open; used for clay. Gives sound jin/qin in 谨 (cautious), 勤 (diligent).

comps.label: standing crowd
comps.says: Three people standing side by side: a crowd. Adds 'many people' to 聚 (assemble); shape in 骤.

comps.label: tripod pot
comps.says: A cooking pot on three hollow legs. Shape and sound ge/rong in 隔 (partition wall), 融 (melt).

comps.label: river fork
comps.says: Lines branching apart: in 派 (river branch) water splitting into streams; in 旅 (journey) the bodies of marching people.

comps.label: hat top
comps.says: A headcover, the top of 冒 (brave risk) set over an eye. Gives the hat sense in 帽 (hat).

comps.label: tailless bird
comps.says: Bird (鸟) without its bottom stroke, so another part can sit inside. Gives sound dao in 岛 (island), 捣 (mash).

comps.label: mourning top
comps.says: A crossed top shared by 丧 (mourning) and simplified 墙 (wall). Shape only; origin unclear.

comps.label: half pig
comps.says: Pig (豕) shortened to fit in a corner, as in 缘 (hem edge) and 毅 (resolute). Shape only.

comps.label: grass blade
comps.says: Said to be a blade of grass; origin unclear. Gives sound tuo/zhai in 托 (prop up), 宅 (residence).

comps.label: pestle foot
comps.says: The left of 卸 (unload): a pestle (午) over a foot (止). Gives the shape of 御 (charioteer); origin unclear.

comps.label: skull top
comps.says: The top of the skull, the baby's soft spot. Shape in 傻 (silly) and 瑙 (carnelian), from the head and brain.

comps.label: tiger claw
comps.says: A claw under the tiger head in 虐 (cruelty): the tiger clawing a person. Shape in 疟 (malaria).

comps.label: hobbled pig
comps.says: A pig (豕) with an extra stroke for its tied legs. Gives sound zhuo in 啄 (peck), 琢 (carve jade).

comps.label: bone shard
comps.says: A form of 歹 (broken bones, death). In 餐 (meal) it sits at the top left with a hand, from an old picture of picking at bones.

comps.label: millet hook
comps.says: A small hooked piece at the top right of 黎 (multitude). Shape only; origin unclear.

comps.label: cord stub
comps.says: Short form of 弟, once a cord wound round a stick in order. In 第 (rank order) it gives sound and the idea of sequence.

comps.label: flail core
comps.says: The middle part of 庚 (flail), an old tool or instrument held in hands. Shape only here.

comps.label: high bird
comps.says: A bird (隹) flying above a border: flying high. It gives the sound he in 鹤 (crane).

comps.label: door leaf
comps.says: The left side of 所 (place), a form of 户 (door). It gives the sound in 所 next to an axe (斤).

comps.label: four hands
comps.says: Two pairs of hands raising something, the frame of 舆 (sedan chair), which people lifted together.

comps.label: corner boxes
comps.says: The lower right part of 临 (look down), simplified from the items a person looks down on. Shape only.

comps.label: sack knot
comps.says: The top of 囊 (sack), from the tied mouth of a bag. Shape only; origin unclear.

comps.label: split log
comps.says: Mirror of 片 (slice): the left half of a tree trunk, a plank. In 藏 (hide away) it is part of the sound piece 臧.

comps.label: straw cape
comps.says: The middle of 衰 (decline), which first drew a straw raincoat with hanging grass. Shape only now.

comps.label: dancer arms
comps.says: The top of 舞 (dance): a person holding tassels or sleeves out while dancing.

comps.label: bird body
comps.says: The bottom of 焉 (how so), which first drew a bird; this is its body and tail. Shape only now.

comps.label: sheep head
comps.says: The top of 养 (raise), from 羊 (sheep) with its horns; it gives the sound yang.

comps.label: tow
comps.says: To tow, pull, drag. In 拽 (yank) it gives sound and meaning beside a hand.

comps.label: boar snout
comps.says: A pig's snout. In 缘 (hem edge) it is the top of the sound part 彖.

comps.label: chin
comps.says: An old drawing of the chin. In 熙 (bright glow) it gives the sound xi.

comps.label: turned body
comps.says: A body (身) turned the other way. In 殷 (flourishing) it sits beside a hand with a stick.

comps.label: battle axe
comps.says: A picture of a battle-axe, like 戈 (dagger-axe). It gives the sound yue in 越 (leap over).

comps.label: pressing hand
comps.says: The left side of 印 (seal stamp): a hand pressing down on a kneeling person, later pressing a seal.

comps.label: lopped tree
comps.says: The left side of 制 (system), from a tree with branches, cut with a knife (刂) to shape it.

comps.label: elder sprout
comps.says: The right side of 姊 (elder sister), giving the sound zi. Shape only; origin unclear.

comps.label: grass shoot
comps.says: A single sprouting plant, half of 艸 (grass). It marks plants and growth inside characters.
